slides.text: cozy date ideas for cold nights

slides.title: go ice skating
slides.detail: rent skates, hold hands so neither of you falls, hot drinks after.

slides.title: take a pottery class
slides.detail: a one-night wheel class. you each keep a lopsided mug to remember it.

slides.title: a holiday lights walk
slides.detail: fill a thermos with hot cocoa and wander the best-lit streets in town.

slides.title: bake a pie together
slides.detail: apple or pumpkin, from scratch. about 2 hours with the oven time.

slides.title: chess by candlelight
slides.detail: phones away, a pot of tea, best of three. loser does the dishes.

slides.text: save this for the next cold weekend
